# France This Way

> > Comprehensive travel guide to France covering destinations, castles, cultural heritage, and practical travel information across regions like Dordogne, Provence, and the Loire Valley.

France This Way is a detailed travel resource helping visitors explore French towns, villages, cities, historic castles, and cultural attractions. The site provides visitor guides, historical context, and practical travel planning information including transportation and accommodation options.

## Key Topics

- France tourism and travel
- French castles and châteaux
- Dordogne region
- Provence region
- Loire Valley
- Medieval and Renaissance architecture
- Cathar castles
- French classical composers
- Historical sites and monuments
- Town and village guides
- French cultural heritage
- Travel planning and transportation
- Opera and classical music history
- Regional vacation ideas

## Destinations and Places to Visit

- [Find and explore any town, village or city in France](https://www.francethisway.com/places-to-visit.php): Search directory for all French towns, villages & cities with attractions

## Castles and Historic Sites

- [Castles in France: history and visitor guides](http://www.castles.francethisway.com/): Main portal for French castles including Loire Valley & Cathar sites

## Travel Planning and Ideas

- [France idées des vacances - inspiration et idées pour vos vacances](https://www.fr.francethisway.com/holiday-ideas.php): French vacation ideas covering Brittany, Arcachon & medieval villages

## French Culture and Arts

- [French Classical music composers](https://www.francethisway.com/culture/musiccomposers.php): Guide to French classical composers: Bizet, Berlioz, Debussy, Ravel

## Transportation and Practical Information

- [Trains to France with cheap Eurotunnel tickets and Rail Europe tickets](https://www.francethisway.com/francetrains.php): Train booking info for Eurotunnel & Rail Europe to France destinations
